description: Permanently wipe and sanitize privacy metadata from image, video, or audio files (strip GPS coordinates, device fingerprints, timestamps, and comments) with zero quality loss.

base64Data.description: Base64 encoded image, video, or audio binary payload (or data URI)

clearDevice.description: Whether to erase camera device fingerprints ('true' or 'false', default 'true')

clearGps.description: Whether to erase GPS coordinates ('true' or 'false', default 'true')

clearTimestamps.description: Whether to zero container recording timestamps ('true' or 'false', default 'true')

fileName.description: Optional filename with extension (e.g. photo.jpg, vlog.mp4, note.wav)

name: sanitize_media_security
